task.title: Array assignment: the postcondition of A[A[0]-1] := A[0]

located_defect.lean_text:
def HoareTriple : Prop := ∀ s : Store, pre s = true → holds post (stepR1 s) = true
-- pre s = (s.length ≥ 2 ∧ A[0] = 2 ∧ A[1] = 3), post s = (s.length ≥ 2 ∧ A[0] = 1 ∧ A[1] = 1)
located_defect.description: The source (stored source line 0029) discusses the assignment A[A[0]-1] := A[0] under the precondition A[0] = 2 ∧ A[1] = 3 and names A[0] = 1 ∧ A[1] = 1 as the correct postcondition. The Hoare triple {pre} A[A[0]-1] := A[0] {post} with that postcondition, under the operational reading stepR1 (index and right-hand side evaluated in the pre-state, out-of-range write is an error), is the located defect. Supply the corrected postcondition, prove the corrected triple from every store satisfying pre, and prove that it is the strongest postcondition (final_theorem).

task.allowed_edit: Replace the hole in `postC` by a Bool predicate on the store (canonical form: decide (s.length ≥ 2) && decide (getI s 0 = c) && decide (getI s 1 = d) with integer literals c, d), not referring to the command or to pre/post; nothing else in the fixed part may change. The precondition pre, the command and its semantics (stepR1, writeAt, setI, getI) and total correctness are fixed; pre may not be strengthened. Do not redefine Store, getI, setI, writeAt, pre, post, stepR1, stepR2, stepR3, holds, resultIs or HoareTriple; no instances, notations, macros, axioms or exports.
